hypothesis: The failure is a pure elaboration/interface-mismatch problem in the top-level assembly, not a logic bug. In rtl/rv32i5.sv the reorder_buffer instance u_rob is connected to ports that the module does not declare (retire_valid, retire_pc, retire_insn, bp_resolve, bp_mispredict) — i.e. the top was wired to a different/older interface contract than the one reorder_buffer actually exports. In parallel, the nets dc_idle (from dcache.idle) and squash_valid (from reorder_buffer.squash_valid) are each driven by a module output AND also assigned/used as procedural or continuous drivers in the top, so the compiler collapses them to implicit uwires with multiple drivers ('Unresolved net/uwire ... cannot have multiple drivers' / 'Output port expression must support continuous assignment'). The constant-select 'sorry' lines are benign tool notes, not the blocker. Fixing the port-name alignment between rv32i5 and reorder_buffer and making each of these nets single-driver (declared as logic and driven only by the submodule output) will clear all 14 elaboration errors.
constraints: Top-level port names, directions and widths in rv32i5 must remain exactly as the frozen §A contract (clk, rst_n, imem_*, dmem_*, dbg_*, halted, exit_code, dbg_features, dbg_retire_*, dbg_bp_*, dbg_ooo_*).

reorder_buffer must actually export every port the top instantiates: retirement observation (retire_valid/retire_pc/retire_insn) and branch-resolve observation (bp_resolve/bp_mispredict), plus squash_valid; the top instance may not referenc

Each intermediate net (dc_idle, squash_valid, and any other submodule output) must have exactly one driver: declare it as logic and connect it only to the submodule output port; never also drive it with assign/always.
Do not change dcache idle semantics: idle is the single blocking-miss-done output defined by the frozen dcache contract.
Preserve single-cycle memory model and rst_n synchronous active-low semantics; do not insert wait states or register submodule responses to work around the compile errors.
Do not alter the teacher TB, spec, or scoring scripts; no hardcoded vectors or fake debug/feature flags.
